info.title: vec-memory standalone protocol
info.description: Standalone service. Default port 8091. All business and admin routes require Bearer credentials; admin routes require administrator credentials. POST/PUT bodies must be JSON objects, at most 4 MiB. This contract is separate from the legacy /api/vec service.
